product_one_liner.value: Lob automates personalized direct-mail creation, printing, delivery, address verification and tracking for businesses sending marketing and transactional mail.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 420 employees as of September 30, 2026.

eng_blog.notes: Harry Zhang explains building Lob’s API; Anthony Chen explains the routing-system architecture and rebuild.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current five-role board lists Business Operations Manager, Corporate Counsel, Enterprise Account Executive, Partner Operations Manager and Senior Manager, USPS Programs; none is a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public API documentation, security and privacy materials, the subprocessor list and ML blog posts. No external product model/provider was disclosed; the ML post describes Lob models under testing rather than an established third-party model deployment.

compliance_certs.notes: Lob claims annual SOC 2 Type 2 audits and support for HIPAA and GDPR requirements. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance frameworks, not standalone certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported round is February 25, 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Enterprise Account Executive appears on the current job board and has a public posting.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 31, 2026 announcement introduces the No-Code Design Suite, including visual template editing, dynamic personalization and a centralized design library.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Andrew Haase’s profile dates his start as VP Finance & Operations at Lob to May 2026, following Flexport.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The case study describes internal Salesforce and Marketo use; the subprocessor list identifies Mailchimp as an email-marketing provider and Mutiny as customer sales-lead management.
